title: Cosmo — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Cosmo.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Smart Savings." Value tier. Cosmo Appliances offers kitchen products — range hoods, ranges, and dishwashers — at the lowest price points in the market. Popular on Amazon and online retailers. Basic functionality at unbeatable prices.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Extreme budget buyers. Amazon shoppers. Rental property outfitting.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Cosmo:

• Lowest prices in the market for basic kitchen appliances

• Strong Amazon presence with good reviews at the price point

• Range hoods under $200 that actually work

• Basic functionality without unnecessary complexity

• Quick delivery through online channels
